games.title: Neon Survivor Legends
games.tagline: Survive the swarm, fuse legendary powers.
games.description: Level seven base weapons to max and fuse them in pairs. Hold exactly three Fusions at once to unlock a Super Fusion. Endless roguelite survival against a swarm that never stops growing.
games.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space to dash, 1-3 to pick

games.title: Neon Speed Simulator
games.tagline: Gather speed, unlock skins and trails.
games.description: Build up raw speed, spend it on upgrades, and unlock skins with trails in the hangar. Sign in to keep your progress across sessions, or jump straight in as a guest.

games.title: Orbit Dash
games.description: Hop between orbits, dodge the debris, chase the high score. A demo game that proves the shell works - replace or delete it once your real games are in.
